projects.title: Retail Business Intelligence Dashboard
projects.description: An end-to-end Power BI solution designed to transform retail sales and customer data into clear commercial insights.
highlights: Tracked 965.79K in revenue, 375.35K in profit, and a 38.86% profit margin
Identified the Vape category as the largest revenue contributor at 43.34%
Flagged 17 products at the reorder threshold while inventory coverage remained 89.38%

caseStudy.businessProblem: Retail decision-makers needed a consolidated view of sales, customers, products, inventory, and branch performance.
caseStudy.dataset: Retail business data covering sales, customer behavior, products, inventory, and branches.
analyticalApproach: Cleaned and transformed the data with Power Query
Built a structured Power BI data model
Created DAX measures and KPI reporting
Designed interactive report pages for commercial and operational analysis
keyFindings: Revenue reached 965.79K, generating 375.35K in profit at a 38.86% margin
The Vape category produced 418.55K, or 43.34% of total revenue
Returning customers contributed 501.23K, or 51.9% of revenue
17 products reached the reorder threshold while overall inventory coverage remained 89.38%
caseStudy.businessImplications: The solution supports monitoring sales performance, customer behavior, product movement, inventory risk, and branch trends.
caseStudy.limitations: Results depend on the completeness and accuracy of the supplied retail dataset.

projects.title: University Database Analysis
projects.description: A database and business intelligence analysis of student performance, course capacity, teaching quality, and academic compliance.
highlights: Analyzed 591 registered students and 2,065 enrollment and grade records

caseStudy.businessProblem: Academic stakeholders needed reliable reporting on student performance, course capacity, teaching quality, and prerequisite compliance.
caseStudy.dataset: A university database containing 591 registered students and 2,065 enrollment and grade records.
analyticalApproach: Queried and validated academic records using SQL
Used Python for data validation and analytical checks
Built Power BI dashboards for academic and operational reporting
Distinguished unique students from enrollment and grade records
caseStudy.businessImplications: The analysis supports prerequisite enforcement, academic monitoring, capacity planning, and data-quality improvement.
caseStudy.limitations: The available major information does not support claims about which named major is the largest.

projects.title: Oil Well #807 Production Analysis
projects.description: A reproducible analysis of long-term oil production, pressure, water cut, decline behavior, and preliminary EOR screening.
highlights: Analyzed 2,939 daily operating records from 2013 to January 2021
Measured an 89.8% decline in oil rate

caseStudy.businessProblem: The analysis examined long-term production decline, pressure depletion, water behavior, and preliminary indicators relevant to mature-well performance.
caseStudy.dataset: 2,939 daily operating records from January 2013 to January 2021.
analyticalApproach: Cleaned and analyzed time-series operating data using Python and Pandas
Examined oil rate, pressure, water cut, and decline behavior
Performed preliminary EOR screening using limited available indicators
keyFindings: The dataset contains 2,939 daily operating records
caseStudy.businessImplications: The findings support further technical investigation of mature-well performance and production-optimization options.
caseStudy.limitations: The dataset alone does not establish the cause of the May 2020 interruption. EOR findings are preliminary screening only.

projects.title: Global Data Science Survey Analysis
projects.description: A reproducible analysis of global data-science demographics, professional roles, education, geography, and workforce representation.
highlights: Identified ages 25–34 as the largest age group
Identified Data Scientist as the largest professional role, with 17,128 respondents

caseStudy.businessProblem: The analysis examined global data-science demographics, professional roles, geography, education, and workforce representation.
caseStudy.dataset: 106,301 valid survey responses after removing the survey-question row.
analyticalApproach: Cleaned and standardized survey responses using Python and Pandas
Corrected age-group and job-title mapping errors
Created corrected demographic and workforce visualizations
keyFindings: Ages 25-34 represent the largest age group
Data Scientist is the largest professional role with 17,128 respondents
The selected Arab-country sample contains 2,292 respondents
caseStudy.businessImplications: The analysis provides evidence about workforce composition, professional roles, demographic representation, and regional participation.
caseStudy.limitations: The analysis is descriptive and should not be used to infer causal relationships.
